note: Corps of Engineers campground at the Lake Winnibigoshish dam, where the lake drains into the Mississippi, near Deer River. Sites are in red pine and hardwood forest; boat ramp to the river by the picnic shelter, and the nearest Lake Winnie access is about a mile north-east on Plug Hat Road. Not the Forest Service's Winnie Campground. --Claude
summary: rec.gov read: 22 electric sites (17 at 50 A, 5 at 30 A) with water, $30 every site (stored $24 was wrong), 21 reservable + site 02 walk-up, 14-night max, showers/flush/vault/dump. Rate season May 1 - Oct 14 (not used as season); 2026 calendar shows bookings through Oct 14. Not waterfront kept; pin OK.
flags: Fees: nightly $24 -> $30 (rec.gov catalog and the 2026-2028 rate tables all show $30; the stored $24 has no source behind it on the current pages).

Season: not written. rec.gov states no campground dates; the rate tables' 'Peak Season' May 1 - Oct 14 is a rate season, and the 2026 calendar shows reserved nights through Oct 14 only (earlier months no longer queryable). recgov_calendar.py would be the tool to set it.

Waterfront: keep not waterfront. Imagery: every site is in continuous forest; the Mississippi tailwater below the dam is ~150-200 m south-west of the nearest sites (01, 03, 05) past the day-use parking lot; Lake Winnie is above the dam and out of sight.
Pin 47.43000,-94.04840 sits between sites 01 and 03: OK.
